messages:
Taylor: kicking off v2.5.1 canary to us-west (change window)  initial 7% across embeddings + chat-rerank. deploy-bot: rollout 6219 started at 1765432101 -> https://deploys.redwood/6219. Traffic=7% across routes.

Rae: watching embeddings p95 and error budget. Owen pls watch chat-rerank p50/p95.

SLO-alert-bot: [WARN] embeddings p95 creep: 200ms -> 380ms in last 2m (threshold 350ms)

Owen: chat-rerank p95 ok but rerank 5xx in us-west ticked to 0.9% (threshold 0.4%). Link: https://console.redwood/slo/rerank-route/us-west

Taylor: hmm both routes showing signal but embeddings latency is the earlier signal. Any shared infra? eng-runtime?

eng-runtime: seeing thread contention on nvidia-cp-7 for small batches. logs: `2026-03-24T09:18:10Z warn: kernel-launch-queue-length=42` and occasional rpc timeouts to model-worker-11. Could be a packing/batching change in v2.5.1.

Rae: decision options: (A) full rollback; (B) pin rerank to v2.5.0 and reduce embeddings traffic; (C) split embeddings to fallback pool then observe. Prefer minimal user impact.

Owen: prefer B for rerank since 5xx is scary; embeddings we can split. That avoids global rollback.

Taylor: agree. Execute: pause rerank in us-west and pin to v2.5.0; for embeddings, run traffic-split to gpu-pool-fallback 80%. Commands ready.

Owen: `deployctl pause --rollout=6219 --route=rerank --region=us-west` -> success at 1765432160.

deploy-bot: pause acknowledged.

Owen: `deployctl pin --route=rerank --region=us-west --version=v2.5.0 --reason='canary-5xx-spike'` -> pin successful at 1765432170. rerank us-west reverted.

Rae: running split: `deployctl split --route=embeddings --from=gpu-pool-7 --to=gpu-pool-fallback --percent=80` -> success at 1765432185. embeddings traffic now 80% on fallback.

SLO-alert-bot: [INFO] rerank 5xx returned to baseline after pin (0.15%). embeddings p95 dropped to 220ms after split. error-budget burn down.

Taylor: solid. release-notes-bot add note to PR: "Partially pinned rerank in us-west to v2.5.0 and shifted embeddings to fallback pool during canary due to latency/5xx signals; investigating batching/kernel queue behavior."

release-notes-bot: PR updated https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/372 at 1765432200

eng-runtime: collecting traces and queue metrics now. uploading preliminary flamegraphs: https://s3.redwood/6219/queue-flame-1765432210.svg. Early find: packing policy in runtime causes some shards to queue larger batches to gpu-pool-7 under v2.5.1.

Taylor: eng-runtime to follow up with a CL to adjust packing thresholds and smoke test on gpu-pool-7. Keep embeddings split for 15m and monitor. If stable, we can re-merge traffic; if not, escalate to rollback.

Owen: will watch p95/5xx and post updates every 5m.

Rae: creating incident INC-6219 and adding eng-runtime + eng-sre for deeper metrics correlation.

Taylor: summary for execs: targeted pin/split applied to avoid broad rollback; canary continues in non-affected lanes; engineering investigating kernel/packing regression. Closing thread until updates.

Owen: :thumbsup: will update if we see another alert.
